sections.title: Summary
sections.body:
**The Surface redesign and a five-commit relay closeout recovery chain carried the day in `james-brennan`, while nightly PR maintenance failed outright on a credential broker rejection and 9 of 25 fleet gateway units are not running.**

## What happened

### james-brennan: Surface redesign merged, relay closeouts made recoverable
71 of 93 commits, PRs #289 through #314. The shadcn Surface redesign reached `main` via #293/`81ab80de`, carrying the audience split — `ff3137a1` "split the Surface by audience; Jim sees no testbed and no Miami Beach", with `70e4e550` and `0f7165cd` serving and republishing per-audience queue keys. Note `8be5b6f0`, committed as "unfinished — session limit": the shadcn primitives work was cut off mid-stream.

The relay post-call path got a sustained fix sequence: `7ad15e18` recovers held closeouts from recorded calls, `074ad502` records partial review attempts, `b28def4f` shares the store engine with the report repository, `44197fa6` reports post-call failures as errors instead of swallowing them, and `12146459` resolves the recording archive from call SID. Billing touched twice — `a5c2ce72` (approved job state + Miami test invoice mapping) and `c320f7c9` (1622 Washington testbed tax rule).

Two commits are governance, not code: `b6aeb3dd` banners the anti-switch/anti-shadcn design sources SUPERSEDED, and `59f1a4de` asserts that operator asks outrank headers, tests and design docs.

### bloodbank: hook-hub memory capture
11 commits reworking what gets retained. `9bf3796` makes session write-back capture each turn's ask and outcome rather than code; `ca02d65` gives recall a real deadline against the primary bank; `d9681dc` revives jot on its own OpenRouter key, routed by the payload's cwd; `4220b4e` captures Codex heredoc writes and adds a 2h idle flush; `8f501ee` sizes 400-retries by the server's own token count.

### 33GOD: planning only
7 commits, zero implementation — Epic 2 stories for a repo-independent named specialist workforce (`b1da504`), the Story 2.1 Portable Named Agent Contract spec draft (`bd3eaec`), the first `sprint-status.yaml` (`04fdea4`), and a bloodbank submodule bump to `7d1ac8f`.

Separately, `chore(hermes): refresh PM scaffold to template a9b76f4` swept seven repositories.

## Needs you

- **pr-crusher is dead, not idle.** Its one tick on `delorenj/mcp-server-trello` failed: the credential broker rejected both `prc_github_read_token` and `prc_github_write_token`. 0 PRs triaged. Its Bloodbank publisher is also observed disabled, so the bus will not tell you when this breaks again.
- **9 gateway units not running** across 25 agents (7 unknown to systemd, 2 inactive), plus `hermes-tonnybox-pm-consumer.service` not-found.
- **Two cron jobs claim `ok` while contradicted.** `delodocs-triage-second-pass` runs daily without its `obsidian` and `llm-wiki` skills installed; the Board Cranker loop has been disabled since 2026-09-05 and is missing six skills.
- Developer activity is **partial** — pagination stopped at the 50,000-event budget, so 2026-09-26 is not fully covered. 3 `james-brennan` commits sit off `main`.

## Worth noting

93 commits and **zero decisions recorded**. Report delivery is clean (6/6, streak 6), but five of the last six days were claimed partial — only 2026-09-25 was complete.
